title: Central government pension
text: The family applies for family pension in Form 14 with a copy of the death certificate: to the bank that pays the pension if the amount is in the pension order, otherwise to the Head of Office. State pensions may differ, so contact the pension office.
contact: The bank that pays the pension, or the Head of Office
confirms: CPAO FAQ 47: apply in Form 14 with death certificate, to the disbursing authority if in the PPO, else Head of Office.
